image-generation.prompt-elaborate:
A 45-year-old Italian woman (use Elena Higgsfield reference), lived-in face with subtle fine lines, warm brown shoulder-length hair tied in a low casual ponytail. Sitting on the edge of a soft couch in a clean modern Italian living room at late morning natural light. She wears soft cream lounge pants and a fitted black tank top (suggesting just-back-from-or-going-to a workout, but NOT in a Pilates studio).
She holds a phone in her left hand showing a generic fitness app/Pilates booking interface (not specific brand visible). Her right hand makes a subtle "so-so" gesture - hand flat, slightly tilted, palm down - the universal "ehhh" Italian gesture.
Camera: iPhone 15 Pro vertical shot, eye level, subject distance 110cm (medium shot upper body), natural posture.
Light: single soft window light from camera-right at 30°, color temperature 5000K (neutral late morning), subtle ambient fill from white ceiling, soft realistic.
Expression: Italian "lo sguardo del 'guarda, te lo dico io'" - left eyebrow micro-raised 2mm, mouth in slight smirk right corner, eyes direct camera with friendly skepticism. Head tilted right 5° for "let me give you the real take" body language.
Aesthetic reference: Modern Italian fitness coach Instagram 2026 - Federica Fontana, Cristina Marino aesthetic. NOT cinematic editorial. NOT golden hour Mediterranean.
Body: real Italian woman 45, average proportions, real arms with subtle definition (consistent with someone who works out moderately), NOT model thin.
Color grading: neutral white balance + 3% warmth max, slight pop on cream couch and her tank top.
Composition: subject left-of-frame, phone visible mid-frame, "so-so" gesture clearly readable, plenty of clean negative space top 18% and bottom 18% for brand overlay.
image-generation.negative-prompt: cinematic editorial, Sofia Coppola, golden hour Mediterranean, Pilates studio setting, reformer machine visible, fitness model body, dramatic lighting, instagram filter, beauty retouch, makeup heavy, gym
